inventory.column_rule: frozen sort-beta into 40 groups of 50; same ordinal beta column paired across speeds

descriptor.scope: 부호 있는 힘 변화. 음수는 감소. 0.1초 창의 평균값 차이이며, 정확한 순간 5cm 힘 차이가 아니다.

bootstrap.cluster: 40 beta positions, all three speeds jointly
bootstrap.conditioning: fixed prediction; excludes training coefficients, descriptor and new-session uncertainty

execution_choices.likelihood: stable normal interval likelihood; single Nelder-Mead start [0,log(.5)], legacy defaults
execution_choices.identification: reject one-sided-only, overlapping-all-residual intervals, optimizer failure/nonfinite/sigma collapse
execution_choices.secondary_variants: K3,t=.1/.3,nominal axis deferred; cannot reverse primary verdict
execution_choices.hash_note: input SHA256 reads opaque bytes only; no outcome column is parsed
